teams.synopsis: Not a pretty Week 10 win, but back atop the rankings on pure championship-team feel.
teams.blurb: Was the win in Week 10 pretty? Not at all, but a win is a win. Moving back up to the top of the rankings is less about how this team performed in Week 10 and more about them simply having the 'it' factor that all championship teams have. Also, doesn't hurt to add a unanimous top-5 fantasy WR. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 116.2 (12th). Current record: 9-1. Projected: 12-2.

teams.synopsis: A nasty dud in Week 10 handed the division lead to Grits — but that came without the QB1 and the kicker.
teams.blurb: A nasty dud in Week 10 gave STD their 4th loss on the season, surrendering the division lead to Station Grits in the process. Still, the team played without the QB1 and their kicker. I expect a bounce back in Week 11 as the team tries to reclaim that top-two seed once again. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 117.4 (13th). Current record: 6-4. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Could this team be ranked even higher? Wants to see the high-scoring weeks come more consistently first.
teams.blurb: Could the team be higher than 3rd? I think so, but I want the high-scoring weeks to be more consistent. Week 11 should be a fun one against a bottom-ranked team, but after that the team has three tough matchups to finish the season. Could we be witnessing another 2021-type season? Remaining opponent average PF/G: 112.4 (8th). Current record: 8-2. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: A rough Week 11 draw missing Taylor, Wilson, Olave, and potentially Dobbins — still a legit dark horse for the title.
teams.blurb: Week 11 is shaping up to be a rough one for LP — no Taylor, Wilson, Olave, and potentially Dobbins. Still, the team is in good position to secure a top-6 seed in the playoffs, and they have enough firepower to make a run at the championship. I like LP as a dark horse. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 111.0 (5th). Current record: 7-3. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: The talk of the town, hitting a 2025 personal-record ranking — a 4th 141+ point week this season shows a real ceiling.
teams.blurb: The talk of the town. RWB has been climbing the ranks week after week and officially reaches their PR for 2025 of 5th. I like this team a lot to have a late-season surge and make a push for the ring. Week 10 was their 4th week this season with over 141 points, showcasing a ceiling only a few possess. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 111.5 (6th). Current record: 5-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Back over 120 points in back-to-back weeks after a rough stretch — a scary schedule still lies ahead.
teams.blurb: Are they back? After two weeks with less than 80 points in each matchup, the team has responded and put up over 120 points in Weeks 9 and 10. The schedule is scary to finish the season, facing the 2nd-, 3rd-, 5th-, and 10th-ranked teams, but I believe in them to secure a couple wins. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 120.5 (14th). Current record: 7-3. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Just 60 points in Week 10, but a bounce-back win in Week 11 would all but guarantee a playoff berth.
teams.blurb: Just 60 points in Week 10 for NY, but I think the team will bounce back and have a great finish to the season. The matchup is tough in Week 11, but if the team can somehow manage a win, then I would guarantee a playoff berth. Let's see how things play out. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 113.1 (9th). Current record: 5-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Two tough losses in a row, but averaging 122 a game over the last month keeps the playoff hope alive.
teams.blurb: Two weeks in a row of tough losses, but I still think there's hope for them. The next two weeks will be crucial, but if the team can win them, then they have a great shot at playoffs. Don't forget, they're averaging 122 points per game over the last month and are projected over 130 in Week 11. Current record: 4-6. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: A pleasant surprise these past two weeks, capped by the franchise's fastest-ever 50th all-time win.
teams.blurb: These past two weeks have been a pleasant surprise for Cooking, but will it continue long enough to secure a playoff spot? The franchise claimed their 50th all-time win in Week 10, the fastest to do so. The odds of making playoffs are in their favor, but a couple more wins will be needed. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 110.3 (3rd). Current record: 5-5. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: 3-7 through 10 weeks, with the playoff door nearly shut — the easiest remaining schedule in the league offers a sliver of hope.
teams.blurb: Who would've thought The Minutemen would be 3-7 through 10 weeks, not me! The hope to make playoffs is very small and almost out the door, but the easiest strength of schedule to finish the season does inspire something. Their season isn't over yet, but it will take a strong November. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 108.3 (1st). Current record: 3-7. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: Sitting between 9th and 11th since Week 5 — flashes of brilliance, but never quite enough consistency.
teams.blurb: This team has sat between 9 and 11 in the rankings since Week 5. They've shown flashes, like a 144-point week in Week 4 or a 128-point week in Week 9, but for every good week they have a bad one, and the cycle continues. The team can make the playoffs, but they'll need to stay consistent. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 109.3 (2nd). Current record: 4-6. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A close Week 10 loss to Grits that would've made things very interesting — one more win is needed to feel safe.
teams.blurb: Welp, the Week 10 loss to Grits was a close one, and that win really would've made things interesting for Burn. Alas, the team sits at 3-7 with the least amount of PF/G — they're scoring about 95 points a week, and the next-lowest is TTF with 100 points a week. They need one more win to feel safe. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 114.4 (11th). Current record: 3-7. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: TTF secured their 2nd win of the season, backed by big performances up and down the roster.
teams.blurb: They did it. TTF secured their 2nd win of the season in Week 10, backed by great performances from Waddle, Jeudy, Warren, and the Chargers D/ST. They'll need to produce like that again for TTF to avoid punishment and hopefully secure another win in the final four weeks. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 114.0 (10th). Current record: 2-8. Projected: 3-11.

teams.synopsis: Not even bottom two in PF/G, yet stuck at the bottom heading into Week 11 — last place comes down to the final month.
teams.blurb: Although the team isn't even bottom two in PF/G, they find themselves at the bottom as we head into Week 11. I think TTF getting a win last week makes things very interesting, making last place come down to the final month of the season. I also don't love the Rashee Rice trade for them. Remaining opponent average PF/G: 110.9 (4th). Current record: 2-8. Projected: 3-11.
